Title: Stupid Timing Question: Troglodytia vs. AI

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If Troglodytia is bleeding for more than 3 (it doesn't matter how), and the
target plays Archon Investigation, can her controller use her special ability
before she burns?

I assume "yes", because cards are played and replaced before their
effects are resolved. I'm just looking for confirmation.

Happy New Year!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
